name: pleiades
description: Pleiades — the news layer for Solana agents. Real-time beats, bounded cited packs, and metered payment over x402 or a prepaid USDC balance.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pleiades/contracts && npm run build -w @pleiades/db && npm run build -w @pleiades/sdk && npm run build -w @pleiades/realtime && npm run build -w pleiades-api && npm run build -w pleiades-worker && npm run build -w pleiades-bots && npm run build -w pleiades-web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @pleiades/contracts && npm run build -w @pleiades/db && npm run build -w @pleiades/sdk && npm run build -w @pleiades/realtime
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w pleiades-worker && npm run build -w pleiades-api && node --test packages/contracts/dist/*.test.js apps/worker/dist/*.test.js packages/realtime/dist/*.test.js apps/api/dist/lib/*.test.js
